prompt: Let's work out a unified UI theme and design system for the whole app. It should feel clean, professional, and dark-mode oriented for medical doctors in low-light ultrasound rooms. Tell me what changes we need to make to the theme, styling, and widget colors, and write down the instructions for the developer.

assertions.text: Inspects existing app configuration and theme definitions
assertions.evidence: Finds custom blue seed color 0xFF0F4C81 in main.dart.

assertions.text: Proposes a dark-mode palette tailored for ultrasound/medical clinical use cases
assertions.evidence: Suggests low-fatigue charcoal/slate dark theme with high contrast blue/teal active indicators.

assertions.text: Proposes structured design tokens (colors, typography, radii) for the design system
assertions.evidence: Defines custom Hex color tokens and Typography sizes.

assertions.text: Outlines a clear task list for modifying the Flutter theme code
assertions.evidence: Provides a developer task list for ThemeData config updates.
